about: Sites already made whose .github/ci/signers.mjs and .github/workflows/pages.yml still read team/keys.json from SovereignWebsite__Factory, the IaC repository's old name. Org apply rewrites only that name to SovereignWebsite__IaC in those two files, in one commit on the site's dev, and only for the repositories listed here. GitHub's redirect keeps the old address working meanwhile; moving every site lets the old name never matter again. Dinis Cruz, 23 Nov 2026 in factory.c's session: "let's start moving one. Pick one and let's see how it can work".
